name: Yusuf ibn Tashfin
contribution: A Sanhaja leader of the Almoravid Empire.
legacy: He co-founded the city of Marrakesh and led the Muslim forces in the Battle of Sagrajas.

checks.lead: Yusuf ibn Tashfin, also Tashafin, TeShufin, (Arabic: يوسف بن تاشفين ناصر الدين بن تالاكاكين الصنهاجي, romanized: Yūsuf ibn Tāshfīn Naṣr al-Dīn ibn Tālākakīn al-Ṣanhājī, Berber languages: ⵢⵓⵙⴼ ⵓⵜⴰⵛⴼⵉⵏ; reigned c. 1061 – 1106) was a Sanhaja leader of the Almoravid Empire. He co-founded the city of Marrakesh and led the Muslim forces in the Battle of Sagrajas.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
